name: Cerebras
summary: Cerebras builds wafer-scale AI chips and sells high-speed inference on them through a public cloud API, dedicated capacity and on-prem systems. The shared API serves a small set of open-weight models at thousands of tokens per second; OpenAI has contracted 750 MW of Cerebras capacity for its own customers.
facts: Free tier with $5 credit, pay-as-you-go credits, enterprise by agreement
OpenAI, multi-year 750 MW deal announced Jan 2026
600 MW of data center capacity under contract (vendor-reported)
goodFor: Fast agent loops on open models
watchOut: Free-tier context is shorter than paid (e.g. 65k vs 131k)
